subject: PHI scope and BAA — decision criteria & legal/procurement kickoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@medsys.io>, Procure Team <procure@medsys.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: PHI scope and BAA — decision criteria & legal/procurement kickoff

Hi Elena / procurement team — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- MedSys primary use case: document summarization and chart extraction from referral letters and discharge notes; some fields will contain PHI (names, MRN, dates).
- Goal: determine if Redwood can be cleared to process the PHI you need in production and which hosting modes are acceptable (Hosted with BAA, Dedicated, Private/VPC, or on-prem).
- Compliance asks raised: BAA availability, SOC 2 Type II report, retention & audit logs, and encryption/KMS integration.

Key decision criteria we need from MedSys to finalize eligibility:
1) PHI boundary: Which elements are strictly required for model inference vs. can be redacted? (e.g., full MRN vs truncated id)
2) Throughput/latency SLOs: expected RPS and 95th pct latency target for summaries and extraction pipelines.
3) Region & data residency: US-only or need EU/APAC options?
4) Acceptable hosting modes: can you operate with Redwood Hosted under a signed BAA, or do you require Dedicated/Private/offline on-prem?

Proposed next steps (action items):
- Elena / Procure: share a short PHI scope matrix that lists the fields you must send to the model and which can be masked (target: today EOD). Attachment: please use the medsys_phiscope_matrix.xlsx we discussed.
- Monica (tech): I asked her to prepare a one-page deployment matrix that maps your PHI scope to our eligible hosting modes and the minimal additional controls (SOC 2, KMS, VPC peering). Monica will attach a redwood_service_modes.pdf and our SOC 2 summary.
- Aditya (sales): will prepare preliminary pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted-with-BAA and an initial procurement checklist for your legal team.
- Redwood/MedSys legal loop: once PHI scope received, we’ll route a draft BAA and Ops Addendum to your counsel for review.

Please confirm if the above captures your expectations and whether you can populate the attached matrix today. If helpful we can schedule a short 30-min follow-up to walk through the matrix and our deployment options.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivеk@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_service_modes.pdf (overview of Hosted/Dedicated/Private), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary, not full report)
From: Elena Martinez <elena@medsys.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@medsys.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: PHI scope and BAA — decision criteria & legal/procurement kickoff

Thanks Vivek — the recap looks right. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PHI boundary: We do need patient identifiers (name, DOB, MRN) in the extraction step, but for the summarization output we can provide hashed identifiers. We’ll mark fields in the attached matrix.
- Hosting modes: Preference is Hosted with a signed BAA if you can provide the following controls: SOC 2 Type II, customer-managed KMS for key rotation, and per-tenant audit logs with 1 year retention. If Hosted cannot meet customer-managed KMS, we will evaluate Dedicated or Private.
- Throughput: initial pilot 10 RPS with bursts to 50, 95th latency target < 800ms for extract pipeline.

Procurement note: we’ve started a purchase request number PR-7789 (Procure Team). Legal wants to see the BAA draft and an ops addendum showing data flow diagrams. Can you include a sample data flow diagram in the follow-up?

I’ll return the filled medsys_phiscope_matrix.xlsx by EOD.

—Elena
Elena Martinez
Director of Product Operations | MedSys Health
elena@medsys.io
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@medsys.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 07:36:00 -0000
Subject: Re: PHI scope and BAA — decision criteria & legal/procurement kickoff

Elena — thanks, that clarifies a lot. Quick technical notes and what I’ll attach: 

1) PHI handling modes (short):
- Hosted + BAA: Supported. We can offer per-customer key separation, but full customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-HSM) is available only in Private/Dedicated with VPC peering today. Hosted with BAA supports envelope encryption with Redwood-managed KMS and customer rotation policies.
- Dedicated: Full isolation, supports customer-managed KMS and audit log export to S3/your logging endpoint.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): Full control, can run under your KMS/HSM and air-gapped networks for regulated pilots.

2) Audit logs & retention: We can provide token-level tracing and per-request audit logs with 1 year retention as part of our enterprise package. Longer retention is configurable.

3) SOC 2: attached redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary + how to request the full Type II report under NDA). We typically share the full report under an NDA; if you want I can open an NDA cadence for Legal.

4) Data flow diagram & ops addendum: I’ll include a simple data flow SVG and a one-page ops addendum that maps PHI fields to hosting controls. Attachments: redwood_service_modes.pdf, medsys_phiscope_matrix_filled.xlsx (I’ll prefill a few rows to help).

Next steps from my side: I’ll send attachments and the ops addendum by 12:00 PT today. Vivek / Aditya — please confirm if you want me to include any specific SLAs or logging endpoints for Procure/Legal to review.

Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_service_modes.pdf, redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, medsys_phiscope_matrix_filled.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@medsys.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: PHI scope and BAA — decision criteria & legal/procurement kickoff

Thanks everyone — quick commercial note:

- I’ll push an initial Hosted-with-BAA commercial estimate and a Dedicated baseline by tomorrow AM. For the pilot (10 RPS) we can offer a pilot credit for the first 30 days; I’ll include line items for SSO, one-year audit log retention, and SOC 2 report access.
- Procurement: please send any contract templates or vendor addendum requirements (Procure Team). We’ll route a redwood BAA draft to you once we receive the filled PHI matrix.

If legal wants the full SOC 2 Type II we’ll request an NDA to share the report. Monica — please add the data flow SVG to the Drive link Vivek referenced.

Best,
Aditya
